scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && uv sync --directory backend && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory backend alembic upgrade head && uv run --directory backend uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips 127.0.0.1
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.test: uv run --directory backend pytest -q && pnpm --filter coinvoy-frontend test
scripts.lint: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && pnpm --filter coinvoy-frontend lint
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
